content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DWCD Puducherry Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://wcd.py.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for DWCD Puducherry Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Department of Women and Child Development (DWCD Puducherry) to fill Chairperson and Member positions across various regions under the Dowry Advisory Board.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies have been announced for the Chairperson and Member posts distributed equally among Pondicherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam regions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the filled offline application form is 20-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DWCD Puducherry Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and send it by post along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Chairperson and Member posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 60 years. Age calculations and eligibility are evaluated as of the specified date mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these positions under the Department of Women and Child Development.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Applicants must be respectable and educated citizens of India who are actively engaged in public activity or social work and ordinarily reside within the respective jurisdiction.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium provided for these posts?
faq.answer: According to the official notification details, no honorarium or remuneration will be paid for serving as Chairperson or Member on these boards.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: The filled application should be sent to 'The Director, Department of Women and Child Development, Housing Board Complex, (opp. to LIC) New Saram, Puducherry-13'.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website and download the notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official website at https://wcd.py.gov.in to download the application form and view detailed notifications regarding the recruitment drive.
